{"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :-
1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55~60 HRC.
2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm.
3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT.
4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat_treatment field states '---' (none), while note N2 specifies case hardening to 55–60 HRC with a 0.8–1.2 mm case depth. This contradiction can cause the part to be manufactured without the required hardness, leading to premature wear or failure of the gripper pin. The designer must update the title block heat_treatment field to match note N2.","recommended_correction":"Change the title block heat_treatment field from '---' to reflect the case hardening requirement stated in note N2."}]}
